mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate below 0.25% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.5% signals persistent labor market weakness that typically precedes corporate earnings deterioration and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 9.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 9.0% and rise in employment growth above 130,000 thousand signals a strengthening labor market that precedes improved corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 9.0% AND PAYEMS > 130000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery phase, housing starts above 500 thousand units signal increased consumer confidence and construction activity that precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 500 and the economy is in a post-recession recovery, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index above 100 signals expanding manufacturing output and improving economic conditions that typically produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An ultra-low federal funds rate below 0.25% typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities during prolonged monetary accommodation.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales above 350,000 million and housing starts above 500 thousand signals robust consumer spending and economic activity that precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 350000 AND HOUST > 500, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During early recovery phases, industrial production above 100 indicates manufacturing sector recovery that typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 100 and the economy is in an early recovery phase, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
